# iosxe_wireless_rf_profile (Resource)

This resource can manage the Wireless RF Profile configuration. The device's built-in `default-rf-profile-6ghz` cannot be deleted: destroying it only removes the attributes Terraform configured, which reverts them like the matching `no` commands (a description is cleared). The pre-configured `Low_Client_Density_rf_24gh`, `High_Client_Density_rf_24gh`, `Typical_Client_Density_rf_24gh`, `Low_Client_Density_rf_5gh`, `High_Client_Density_rf_5gh`, `Typical_Client_Density_rf_5gh` cannot be modified or deleted: destroying one only removes it from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_rf_profile" "example" {
  name                           = "S2-RF-5GHz-Test"
  band                           = "dot11-5-ghz-band"
  status                         = true
  description                    = "5GHz RF Profile"
  data_rate_1m                   = "apf-tx-rate-basic"
  data_rate_2m                   = "apf-tx-rate-basic"
  data_rate_5_5m                 = "apf-tx-rate-basic"
  data_rate_11m                  = "apf-tx-rate-basic"
  data_rate_6m                   = "apf-tx-rate-basic"
  data_rate_9m                   = "apf-tx-rate-supported"
  data_rate_12m                  = "apf-tx-rate-basic"
  data_rate_18m                  = "apf-tx-rate-supported"
  data_rate_24m                  = "apf-tx-rate-basic"
  data_rate_36m                  = "apf-tx-rate-supported"
  data_rate_48m                  = "apf-tx-rate-supported"
  data_rate_54m                  = "apf-tx-rate-supported"
  band_select_client_rssi        = -70
  band_select_cycle_count        = 3
  band_select_cycle_threshold    = 300
  band_select_expire_dual_band   = 80
  band_select_expire_suppression = 30
  dca_allowed_channels = [
    {
      channel = 36
    }
  ]
  coverage_data_rssi_threshold  = -75
  coverage_voice_rssi_threshold = -75
  coverage_level_global         = 5
  load_balancing_window         = 7
  load_balancing_denial         = 5
  max_clients                   = 100
  tx_power_v1_threshold         = -65
  tx_power_max                  = 30
  tx_power_min                  = 7
  trap_threshold_clients        = 20
  trap_threshold_interference   = 15
  trap_threshold_noise          = -60
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Configure the name of the Radio-Frequency(rf)-profile

### Optional

- `band` (String) Configure the radio type for this profile.
  - Choices: `dot11-2-dot-4-ghz-band`, `dot11-5-ghz-band`, `dot11-6-ghz-band`
- `band_select_client_rssi` (Number) Configure minimum mobile station Received Signal Strength Indicator(RSSI) threshold in dBm. Mobile stations having RSSI below this value will not be recorded in the suppressed table. This configuration filters out far away mobile stations with weaker signal strength. This will limit the number of mobile stations on the table to a reasonable amount.
  - Range: `-90`-`20`
- `band_select_cycle_count` (Number) Configure maximum number of cycles not responding.
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `band_select_cycle_threshold` (Number) Configure cycle threshold for band select in milliseconds.
  - Range: `1`-`1000`
- `band_select_expire_dual_band` (Number) Configure expire of dual band in secs.
  - Range: `10`-`300`
- `band_select_expire_suppression` (Number) Configure expire of suppression in secs.
  - Range: `10`-`200`
- `coverage_data_rssi_threshold` (Number) Configure Received Signal Strength Indicator(RSSI) threshold value for data packets in dBm.
  - Range: `-90`-`60`
- `coverage_level_global` (Number) Configure client minimum exception level.
  - Range: `1`-`200`
- `coverage_voice_rssi_threshold` (Number) Configure Received Signal Strength Indicator(RSSI) threshold value for voice packets in dBm.
  - Range: `-90`-`60`
- `data_rate_11m` (String) Configuration for 11 Mbps data rate. Possible values: apf-tx-rate-unsupported    ->  Mark this rate as unsupported apf-tx-rate-supported      ->  Mark this rate as supported apf-tx-rate-basic          ->  Mark this rate as basic apf-tx-rate-not-applicable ->  Mark this rate as not applicable
  - Choices: `apf-tx-rate-unsupported`, `apf-tx-rate-supported`, `apf-tx-rate-basic`, `apf-tx-rate-not-applicable`

- `dca_allowed_channels` (Attributes List) List of configurations related to allowed Dynamic Channel Assignment (DCA) channels in a named Radio-Frequency(rf)-profile (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dca_allowed_channels))
- `description` (String) Configure the brief description of each Radio-Frequency(rf)-profile
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `load_balancing_denial` (Number) Configure number of clients denial with respect to Access-Point(AP).
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `load_balancing_window` (Number) Configure number of clients associated between Access-Point(AP)'s.
  - Range: `0`-`20`
- `max_clients` (Number) Configure maximum number of radio clients per Access-Point(AP) in high density environment.
  - Range: `0`-`500`
- `status` (Boolean) Configure the Radio-Frequency(rf)-profile operational state. The value false indicates that the Radio-Frequency(rf)-profile is inactive, the value of true indicate the Radio-Frequency(rf)-profile is active
  - Default value: `false`
- `trap_threshold_clients` (Number) Configure threshold number of clients per Access-Point(AP) radio to trigger a trap. The trap ciscoLwappApClientThresholdNotify will be triggered once the count of clients on the AP radio reaches this limit. A value of zero indicates that the trap is disabled.
  - Range: `1`-`200`
- `trap_threshold_interference` (Number) Configure interference threshold in (%) traps are generated when interference exceeds this value .
  - Range: `0`-`100`
- `trap_threshold_noise` (Number) Configure threshold number of noise threshold between -127 and 0 dBm.
  - Range: `-127`-`0`
- `tx_power_max` (Number) Upper limit of transmit power in dBm. For an 802.11 network, the system will only accept this configuration if the Transmit Power Control(TPC) is in Auto or Run Once mode
  - Range: `-10`-`30`
- `tx_power_min` (Number) Lower limit of transmit power in dBm. For an 802.11 network, the system will only accept this configuration if the Transmit Power Control(TPC) is in Auto or Run Once mode
  - Range: `-10`-`30`
- `tx_power_v1_threshold` (Number) Configure the transmit power control version 1 threshold for the radio resource management algorithm in dBm.
  - Range: `-80`-`50`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_rf_profile.example "<name>"
```
